This directory vendors curve25519-dalek 1.2.6 from crates.io.
Original archive SHA-256 (from Cargo.lock before the patch):
57c0d59fed08e452f286b251f88b2fc64a01f50a7b263aa09557ad7285d9e7fa
The original BSD-3-Clause LICENSE is retained.

Only the two Scalar29/Scalar52 subtraction implementations below differ from
upstream source. Both backport the volatile-read optimization barrier described
in RUSTSEC-2024-0344 and upstream PR 659. No field arithmetic, generators,
transcripts or encodings are changed. The package version remains 1.2.6 so this
is an explicit local backport, not a claim of an upstream patched v1 release.

References:
https://github.com/RustSec/advisory-db/blob/main/crates/curve25519-dalek/RUSTSEC-2024-0344.md
https://github.com/dalek-cryptography/curve25519-dalek/pull/659

The workspace root [patch.crates-io] mapping selects this copy for every legacy
v1 transitive dependency. Cargo patch mappings are NOT inherited by downstream
workspace roots: applications must carry the same mapping (with the appropriate
path to this directory). Do not publish unpatched v1 dependency graphs or silence
version-based audit findings without checking the actual compiled source.
Modern Ed25519 independently uses the upstream curve25519-dalek 4.1.3 release.
This backport addresses the cited issue only, not all possible side channels.

Source diff against the original archive:

--- upstream/src/backend/serial/u64/scalar.rs
+++ patched/src/backend/serial/u64/scalar.rs
@@ -162,6 +162,12 @@
 
     /// Compute `a - b` (mod l)
     pub fn sub(a: &Scalar52, b: &Scalar52) -> Scalar52 {
+        // Backport of the upstream RUSTSEC-2024-0344 optimization barrier.
+        fn black_box(value: u64) -> u64 {
+            // SAFETY: the pointer refers to a live, aligned Copy integer.
+            unsafe { core::ptr::read_volatile(&value) }
+        }
+
         let mut difference = Scalar52::zero();
         let mask = (1u64 << 52) - 1;
 
@@ -176,7 +182,7 @@
         let underflow_mask = ((borrow >> 63) ^ 1).wrapping_sub(1);
         let mut carry: u64 = 0;
         for i in 0..5 {
-            carry = (carry >> 52) + difference[i] + (constants::L[i] & underflow_mask);
+            carry = (carry >> 52) + difference[i] + (constants::L[i] & black_box(underflow_mask));
             difference[i] = carry & mask;
         }
